_desc: Port tester — module (Admin panel → Modules): port ranges by app type and a port check.
title: Find and test ports
intro: Pick an app type to see its port range. Enter a port and check whether it is free on the server.
waiting_text: Enter a host and a port.
no_host_text: Enter an IP address or a host name.
bad_port_text: A TCP/UDP port must be between 1 and 65535.
unknown_text: {host}:{port} did not answer in time — it is not clear whether the port is free.
bad_answer_text: The server did not return a result it could recognise.
